incidents.title: Payment API returns HTTP 503 after deployment
incidents.root_cause: Missing ConfigMap payment-config in the production namespace after the release
incidents.resolution: Reapplied ConfigMap and restarted pods; validated endpoints

incidents.title: Database connection timeout in Order Service
incidents.root_cause: Connection pool exhaustion with locked orders table from a failed migration
incidents.resolution: Killed long transactions, raised pool to 64, re-ran migration offline

incidents.title: Connection pool exhaustion across order and billing pods
incidents.root_cause: Autoscaling added pods without raising PostgreSQL max_connections
incidents.resolution: Raised max_connections and gated autoscaling on DB capacity

incidents.title: Database service unavailable after primary failover
incidents.root_cause: Replica promotion failed due to stale credentials in the connection string
incidents.resolution: Rotated credentials in the Secret and promoted healthy replica

incidents.title: Payment pods in CrashLoopBackOff after image upgrade
incidents.root_cause: Liveness probe timeout too low for cold start in the new image
incidents.resolution: Rolled back image tag and fixed probe timings

incidents.title: Production server CPU utilization exceeded 95 percent
incidents.root_cause: Traffic surge plus nginx worker CPU saturation without autoscaling headroom
incidents.resolution: Scaled gateway replicas and enabled HPA on CPU at 70 percent

incidents.title: User service pods OOMKilled during traffic surge
incidents.root_cause: Memory limit below working set with unbounded response cache
incidents.resolution: Raised limit to 1Gi, capped cache, HPA on memory

incidents.title: Users cannot log in after auth deployment
incidents.root_cause: SSO token signing key rotation skipped in one namespace leaving invalid tokens
incidents.resolution: Applied rotated key Secret and restarted auth pods

incidents.title: Intermittent microservice request timeouts between services
incidents.root_cause: Network policy change dropped DNS responses; conntrack table saturation
incidents.resolution: Rolled back netpol, raised conntrack limits

incidents.title: Production server disk utilization reached 95 percent
incidents.root_cause: Unrotated container logs filled the node disk
incidents.resolution: Cleaned /var/log, enabled logrotate and size-limited emptyDir

incidents.title: Payment 503 responses during canary rollout
incidents.root_cause: Readiness probe failed while database migration still held locks
incidents.resolution: Paused canary, completed migration, resumed rollout

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag causes delayed notifications
incidents.root_cause: Poison message loop on partition 3 with too few consumers
incidents.resolution: Isolated poison message to DLQ and scaled consumers to partition count
